# Flux Sampling

## Summary

```{r tbl-params}
# Read flux sampling table
fs <- read_tsv(params$fs_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Summary table
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Model",
    "Number of solutions",
    "Number of reactions"
  ),
  Value = c(
    params$models,
    nrow(fs),
    ncol(fs[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  )
)

# Render table
kable(summary_df, align = c("l", "c"))

```{r tbl-benchmark}
fs_preview <- fs[1:min(5, nrow(fs)), 1:min(10, ncol(fs))]
kable(fs_preview, align = "c")
```
